_comment: One-off isolation test: BOTH motor-mounted channels (1 and 3) unidirectional, throttle on both, no bidirectional/telemetry PIO program involved anywhere in the group - checking whether the 'ESC does not return to idle after two motors' finding is specific to bidirectional DShot's dshot_bidir_tx/dshot_bidir_rx programs, or happens even with the plain dshot() program.
